name: SikaCeram-960 Epoxy Finish
paste:
SIKACERAM®-960 EPOXY FINISH: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish, April 2026, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikaceram-960-epoxyfinish.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is a powder concentrate to be added to the wash water after grouting tiles with epoxy resin. It removes residual epoxy grout haze.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is used as an added cleaning solution added to the wash water when using epoxy grouting.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - The Product may be used for interior and exterior applications.
    - The Product may only be used by experienced professionals.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Washing aid for epoxy grouting
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Assists with easy removal of epoxy grout haze
    - Easy to handle and use, simply add the powder to the wash water in the cleaning phase of the installation
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: White
    - Appearance: Powder
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 750 g plastic container; Refer to the current price list for available packaging variations.
    - Shelf life: 18 months from date of production
2.6 Storage conditions. The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to the packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 1 : 100; Add approximately 50grams per 5 Litres of clean water.
4.3 Yield. 75–150 m² per container; Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations.
4.4 Equipment.
    - Sponge float
    - Bucket with rollers
    - Grout finishing tool
4.5 Mixing. 1. Follow the mixing ratio of 1 : 100, for example, 50 g of Product to 5 litres of water. 2. Measure out the SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish and pour into a bucket of clean water. 3. Stir manually using a clean tool.
4.6 Important.
    - Risk of staining on natural stone
    - Using the Product on natural stone may result in surface staining. 1. Do not use the Product in combination with natural stone. 2. Apply on a test area if in doubt.
    - Protect the Product from moisture
    - Note: 1. Reseal open containers.
    - Preconditions
    - Observe information such as waiting times in the Product Data Sheet of the joint grouting product. 1. Use a sponge float to wash the surface of the tiles. 2. IMPORTANT Rinse the sponge and change the wash water frequently. Remove any smears or remaining haze. 3. Allow the surface to dry. 4. Repeat the cleaning process if there is any remaining epoxy grout haze.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate temperature.
    | Maximum | +25°C |
    | Minimum | +10°C |
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Using the Product on natural stone may result in surface staining. 1. Do not use the Product in combination with natural stone. 2. Apply on a test area if in doubt.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish, April 2026, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sikaceram-960-epoxyfinish.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish, version 18/06/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sds-sikaceram-960epoxyfinish.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram and SikaSeal Colour Partner Selection Card.pdf, version 19/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/SikaCeram%20and%20SikaSeal%20Colour%20Partner%20Selection%20Card.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
